items.q: What should you remember about **Addiction ≠ doing something a lot**?
items.a: **rats self-stimulate to starvation;** persistence despite destruction is the sine qua non.

items.q: What should you remember about **Genes matter but aren't destiny**?
items.a: **parent alcoholism history beats SNP** panels; substance-specific liking (Humphreys hates opioids; others feel "hole filled").

items.q: What should you remember about **Zero is better than any for alcohol**?
items.a: **red-wine/resveratrol myth from 60** Minutes; 2 drinks/week = tiny but real excess risk.

items.q: What should you remember about **New cannabis ≠ old cannabis**?
items.a: **potency + daily use =** different drug; 15-year-old on modern weed ≈ vodka vs parent's low-alcohol beer.

items.q: What should you remember about **Industries want addicted customers**?
items.a: **slot machines optimized for novelty** not winning; apps ask "how do we make this more addictive?".

items.q: What should you remember about **AA is a free lunch in public health**?
items.a: **Cochrane review; not a cult** (no money grab, can leave anytime); higher power = anything but you.

items.q: What should you remember about **Many pathways to recovery**?
items.a: **baby, prison, AA, willpower,** GLP-1; most recovered people never saw a psychiatrist.

items.q: What should you remember about **Plasticity cuts both ways**?
items.a: **start smoking at 13 →** almost certainly addicted; start at Humphreys's age → probably won't.
